The Chinese characters for Jade

As a transliteration, Jade is usually written 杰德 (Jié dé). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

杰
Jié
outstanding
德
dé
virtue, morality

Origin and meaning

The name Jade has Spanish roots and means “the jade stone”.

About the name Jade

A gemstone name, from the green stone prized in Chinese culture.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “the jade stone”, a Jade calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
